interventions.name: RGS14 gene expression

bioSpec.description: In this study, 2 ml of peripheral blood was taken from each subject. RNA was isolated from peripheral blood followed by cDNA synthesis. RNA and cDNA samples of the subjects were preserved.

identificationModule.officialTitle: Role of Neuralized1 and RGS14 Genes With ASD Patients

primaryOutcomes.description: After RNA isolation from blood samples of the subjects, NEURL1 gene expression was studied by QPCR method. The 2-ΔΔCT method was applied for the relative quantification of the samples that were normalized with ACTB.

After RNA isolation from blood samples of the subjects, RGS14 gene expression was studied by QPCR method. The 2-ΔΔCT method was applied for the relative quantification of the samples that were normalized with ACTB.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Intellectual disability is when a person has certain limitations in cognitive functioning and skills, including communication, social and self-care skills.It was determined according to DSM-IV diagnostic criteria and clinical evaluation.
Relationships of consanguinity between subjects were evaluated in terms of pathogenesis of the disease.
In the presence of a neurological disease in relatives, its relationship with the pathogenesis of the disease was evaluated.
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Presence of Neurological Disease in Relatives

secondaryOutcomes.description: The relationships of the clinical and demographical findings in the study groups with the genes were evaluated statistically.
